en.headline: Police arrest 16 in operation against Tsim Sha Tsui prostitution syndicate
en.dek: West Kowloon officers seized more than HK$13 million in cash and froze over HK$5 million after targeting a group that arranged Thai women for hotel sex work and took a large share of the earnings.
body: Police arrested 16 people in a two-day operation on 8 and 9 October that targeted a transnational prostitution syndicate active in Tsim Sha Tsui, the force said on Saturday.

West Kowloon Regional Crime Unit officers, under the codenames “Thunder 2026” and “Sharp Division”, raided units in a Tuen Mun private estate used as an operation centre and conducted undercover visits to hotel rooms in Tsim Sha Tsui. They arrested four core members, including three brothers who are local and one Thai man, along with three other syndicate members and nine Thai women aged 19 to 33 who were suspected of providing sexual services while on visitor status.

Police said the group arranged for Thai women to fly to Hong Kong, stay in Tsim Sha Tsui hotels and provide sexual services for fees of about HK$700 to HK$1,000 per session, with the syndicate taking roughly 70 per cent. Members used social media groups to advertise the services. Officers seized more than HK$13 million in cash and froze more than HK$5 million in suspected crime proceeds. The 16 people, seven men and nine women aged 19 to 54, face allegations including trafficking in persons, controlling prostitution, living on the earnings of prostitution, and money laundering.
Superintendent Kar Kam-lam of the West Kowloon Regional Crime Unit briefed the media on the case. The defendants are expected to appear at Kowloon City Magistrates’ Court on Monday.

zh.headline: 警破尖沙咀跨國賣淫集團 拘16人檢逾1300萬
zh.dek: 西九龍重案組於8日至9日行動，搞破招攭泰國女子在酒店賣淫並抽取大部分收益的集團，檢獲逾1300萬港元現金並凍結逾500萬港元。
body: 警方周六表示，西九龍總區刑事部於10月8日至9日展開代號「雷霆2026」暨「銳師」行動，成功瓦解一個活躍於尖沙咀的跨國賣淫集團，共拘捕16人。
探員在屯門一個私人屋苑單位進行突擊搜查，該處為運作中心，並在尖沙咀酒店房間進行放蛇。行動拘捕四名骨幹成員，包括三名本地兄弟及一名泰國籍男子，另有三名集團成員，以及九名年齡19至33歲、持旅遊證件的泰國籍女子，她們涉嫌在訪客身份下提供性服務。
警方指，集團安排泰國女子來港入住尖沙咀酒店提供性服務，每次收費約700至1000港元，集團抽取約七成。成員透過社交平台群組宣傳服務。行動中檢獲超過1300萬港元現金，並凍結超過500萬港元懷疑犯罪得益。16名被捕人士（7男9女，19至54歲）涉「販運他人進入或離開香港」、「控制他人賣淫」、「依靠他人賣淫的收入為生」及洗黑錢等罪名。
西九龍總區刑事部警司賈錦琳向傳媒簡述案情。案件下周一在九龍城裁判法院提堂。
